column1: # The runtime images, one per line, tab-separated:
# Tab-separated so the scripts that read it need no parser.
# kind: `mirror` rows are copied unchanged by scripts/mirror.sh. `build` marks
# an image we publish from our own build, of pinned upstream source or of the
# build context itself; the build is scripts/build.sh <name>, from
# build/<name>/. A `build` row's ref is our own published tag
# (ghcr.io/blaktron/<name>:<tag>) and its digest is that tag's manifest, so
# scripts/pin.sh reports a tag that was pushed again; scripts/mirror.sh skips
# Every upstream ref is pinned by digest. scripts/pin.sh reports tags that have
# moved and never edits this file.
# The Agentry server's own images (postgres, minio, redis, the edge, authentik,
# opensearch, secureagentryd) are not listed here.

column5: the tool plane: Docker's MCP gateway, started once per run with --block-network (policy images.gateway)
the vendor's harness image, byte for byte, the default before the build from source (agentry-docker-agent-src); kept for comparison and for policies that pin it
the default harness, Docker Agent built from its pinned upstream commit (build/docker-agent/), amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the docker-agent workflow (agentry-cli policy.DefaultHarnessImage)
builds the local runner image: the GO_IMAGE build-arg of runnerimage/Dockerfile (policy images.goBuilder)
the runner image's runtime base: the FROM of runnerimage/Dockerfile's second stage
installs and runs a QuickAgent's declared npm MCP servers (policy images.nodeRuntime: Node 22, for policies that pin it)
installs and runs a QuickAgent's declared npm MCP servers (policy images.nodeRuntime: Node 24, the default)
installs and runs a QuickAgent's declared PyPI MCP servers (policy images.pythonRuntime: musl, for policies that pin it)
installs and runs a QuickAgent's declared PyPI MCP servers (policy images.pythonRuntime: Debian trixie, glibc, the default, so the manylinux wheels most packages publish install)
the base of the desktop's Unsafe Mode exec images: Kali (kali-rolling) with a command index and an extras list, amd64 and arm64 (agentry-cli images.unsafe); built by the unsafe-kali workflow

the files image: the decoders of the runner's decode step (pandoc, pdftotext, tesseract, Tika, libarchive, libmagic) and its malware check (clamscan), amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the files workflow (agentry-cli images.files)

the PDF renderer's files for export_pdf: Typst built from source without its package downloader (/typst), the Noto fonts and the report designs' families (/fonts) and cmarker (/typst-packages), files only, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the typst workflow (agentry-cli copies them into the runner image)

the Codex harness image: OpenAI's Codex CLI 0.162.0 release binary (musl), verified against OpenAI's sigstore signature, on our alpine:3.22 mirror, uid 10001, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the codex workflow (agentry-cli images.harnessImages.codex, the default for a ChatGPT model sign-in)

the host link image: the OpenSSH client (ssh, sftp, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen) the runner's host link reaches a target host with, on our alpine:3.22 mirror, uid 10001, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the hostlink workflow (agentry-cli's host link)

the search engine for the tools server's grep and glob: ripgrep built from source with its default features, no PCRE2 (/rg, static) and its licences (/licenses), files only, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the ripgrep workflow (agentry-cli copies it into the runner image)

the browser server image: @playwright/mcp 0.0.83 from its lockfile and Debian's Chromium 155.0.8059.79-1~deb13u1 (snapshot 20261022T000000Z) held to its SHA-256, with its Chromium policy (ECH and QUIC off), on our debian:trixie-slim mirror, uid 10001, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the browser workflow (agentry-cli's browser server)

the Coding agent's toolchain image: Debian 13's build-essential, cmake, pkg-config, git, curl and Python 3 with pip and venv (snapshot 20261022T000000Z), Go 1.27.3 and Node 24 with npm, gh 2.103.0, glab 1.124.0, tea 0.16.0, osv-scanner 2.7.0 and gitleaks 8.30.1, on our debian:trixie-slim mirror, uid 10001, no setuid file, no sudo or SSH, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the coder workflow (agentry-cli images.coder)

the Google Workspace MCP server: gog mcp, built from its pinned upstream commit (build/gog/), on our alpine:3.23 mirror, uid 10001, its tools annotated read-only unless started with --allow-write, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the gog workflow (agentry-cli policy.DefaultGogImage)

the Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com MCP server: Softeria's ms-365-mcp-server, built from its pinned upstream commit with Graph's OpenAPI documents pinned (build/ms365/), on our node:24-alpine mirror, uid 10001, its token cache sealed by /opt/agentry/cache-wrap under the runner's key, its account tools left out of stdio mode, amd64 and arm64, signed keyless by the ms365 workflow (agentry-cli images.ms365)

column1: # Build-time only: not pulled by a run, needed to build an image in build/.

column5: build-time only: upstream's docker-agent Dockerfile copies the /docker-mcp CLI plugin out of this floating v2 tag; we copy it out of a digest instead
build-time only: the runtime base of build/docker-agent/ and build/gog/ — upstream builds the harness on alpine 3.23, while the runner image runs on 3.22

build-time only: compiles build/docker-agent/ and build/gog/; Go 1.27.3 for the standard library's advisories up to GO-2026-6809 (upstream still pins 1.27.0) against alpine 3.23, whose musl the harness is statically linked against
build-time only: the base of build/agentry-unsafe-kali/, the Unsafe Mode image (kali-rolling has no release tags; the digest is the pin, re-pinned monthly)
build-time only: compiles build/typst/ (Typst) on alpine 3.22, the runner image's runtime base; the binary is static (musl)

build-time only: the cosign that verifies OpenAI's sigstore signature on the Codex release binary in build/agentry-codex/'s fetch stage (sigstore's own image, signed by keyless@projectsigstore.iam.gserviceaccount.com; the codex workflow checks that signature before it mirrors); only its static binary is copied, into that stage alone
build-time only: the base of build/agentry-browser/, the browser server image (Debian 13, whose archive builds the Chromium it installs from source)
build-time only: installs build/agentry-browser/'s @playwright/mcp from its lockfile, and its node binary (glibc, Node 24) is the one file the browser image takes from it
build-time only: the Go of build/agentry-coder/, the Coding agent's toolchain image, whose /usr/local/go (the Go project's 1.27.3 release, for glibc) is the one tree taken from it

the object store of the core's headless compose stack (deploy/compose/docker-compose.yaml): MinIO RELEASE.2026-09-22T19-25-18Z, AGPL-3.0, whose publisher serves only a latest tag and may stop serving an older digest
